title: alnus glutinosa f. incisa
intro: Alnus glutinosa f. incisa, commonly known as Cut-leaved Alder, is a plant species within the family Betulaceae. This plant has been valued for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from colds, fever, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alnus glutinosa f. incisa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
